question: **Direction: Identify the sentence with the correct spellings.**

options.text: There was not enouf food in the beggar's house.
There was not enough food in the beggar's house.
There was not enauf food in the beggar's house.
There was not enoufh food in the beggar's house.

solution:
The correct answer is **"****There was not enough food in the beggar's house."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The words "enouf, enauf and enoufh" are incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is **"enough."**
 
• It means** **as much or as many of something as necessary. (पर्याप्त, काफ़ी, जितना (मात्रा या संख्‍या) आवश्‍यक हो उतना)
 
 
• ​Example: *We’ve saved **enough**__ money to buy a computer.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.
